_about: India Module 1 headings modelled on CDSCO's CTD guidance for new drug applications (2010 draft), updated for the forms of the New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019 (CT-18 import, CT-21 manufacture). Sub-items under 1.2.3 and 1.3 are kept as single headings in this app. The dossier is a CTD, filed as PDFs through the online portal, without an eCTD backbone. Codes carry an 'in:' prefix in the app.

children.help: Under the New Drugs and Clinical Trials Rules, 2019: Form CT-18 to import a new drug for sale or distribution, Form CT-21 to manufacture one, with the fee paid through the portal. (The 2010 CTD guidance named Form 44, which the 2019 Rules replaced.)

children.title: Legal and Critical Documents
children.help: Authorisation of the Indian agent, import or manufacturing licences, certificate of pharmaceutical product or free sale certificate, GMP certificates, undertakings.

children.title: Coordinates Related to the Application
children.help: Contacts: responsible official, batch release, authorised agent in India (for imports), manufacturing premises.

children.title: General Information on the Drug Product
children.help: Prescribing information (package insert), labels and carton drafts complying with the Drugs Rules, and product particulars.

children.title: Summary of Testing Protocol(s) for Quality Control Testing
Regulatory Status in Other Countries
children.help: Approvals, withdrawals and restrictions elsewhere. A request to waive the local clinical trial (where the drug is approved in specified countries) is argued with this evidence.
